Sample.evidence_source: Two groups of participants were recruited in all states and territories across Australia: (i) adult men who had made a suicide attempt in the previous 6-18 months, for a face-to-face interview, and (ii) adult family and friends of men who had made an attempt in the same time frame, for participation in focus group discussions.
